source: NACA RM L51L28 figure 4 (blade-form curves; the same for all three propellers), traced from a 300 dpi page image; calibration from the axis labels
propellers: NACA 10-(0)(066)-03, 10-(3)(066)-03, 10-(5)(066)-03: NACA 16-series sections, design CL 0, 0.3, 0.5 constant from shank to tip
notes: b/D is constant (0.0666 read, 0.0665 traced) to x = 0.96, then the tip is rounded.
theta - beta(0.75R) reads 0 at 0.75R to the trace's accuracy; the plotted beta curve is for beta(0.75R) = 44.92 deg (45 deg nominal).
The beta trace ends at x = 0.94 (beyond it is extrapolated along the last slope); h/b is traced to 0.97 and taken at 0.94 here.
